# BabakCast

> An Android podcast player application built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.

## Overview

BabakCast is a modern Android podcast player with clean UI, podcast discovery, episode management, and seamless playback. Built with Clean Architecture and MVVM pattern.

## Links

- GitHub: https://github.com/cocodedk/BabakCast
- Website (EN): https://cocodedk.github.io/BabakCast/
- Website (FA): https://cocodedk.github.io/BabakCast/fa/
- Author: https://cocode.dk
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/babakbandpey

## Technical Details

- Language: Kotlin
- Framework: Jetpack Compose, Android SDK
- Architecture: Clean Architecture + MVVM
- Build: Gradle (Kotlin DSL)
- License: Apache-2.0

## Key Files

- `app/src/main/java/` — Application source code
- `build.gradle.kts` — Build configuration
- `version.txt` — Semantic version
- `CLAUDE.md` — AI session instructions
